[center][size=6][b]Dynamic Splitscreen[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Renegade Ops-style dynamic splitscreen for Stardew Valley local co-op[/i][/size]
[b]Version 0.3.3[/b] | Author: [b]IIIHessonIII[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]What's New in v0.3.3 (Cutscene Camera & Takeover Fix + Experience Updates Co-op Compatibility)[/b][/size]

[table][tr][th]Area[/th]
[th]Highlights[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Cutscene Camera Centering & Takeover Lock ([i]BUG-27, Live Verified[/i])[/b][/td]
[td]Fixed multiplayer cutscenes appearing uncentered or clipped (verified live on Willy's Beach cutscene) via [font=Courier New]EventViewportLayout[/font], normalized [font=Courier New]DestNormRect[/font] UV mapping, [font=Courier New]PointClamp[/font] sampling, and center-preserving [font=Courier New]startEvent[/font]/[font=Courier New]InitializeEvent[/font] resize guards (protecting [font=Courier New]-63968[/font] offscreen sentinels while leaving minigames and [font=Courier New]farmEvent[/font] untouched). Also fixed P1 permanently locking into full screen after an independent cutscene via [font=Courier New]ForceSplitReason.Cutscene[/font], reserving [font=Courier New]ForceFullscreen[/font] strictly for true shared events (Sleep, FarmEvent, both-scripted Festival, both-Wedding) while honoring [font=Courier New]FullscreenOwnerIndex[/font].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Experience Updates Co-op Support ([i]Nexus #7581, BUG-28[/i])[/b][/td]
[td]Added zero-dependency compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7581]Experience Updates[/url] ([font=Courier New]Quipex.ExperienceUpdates[/font] v1.0.1+) with conditional GMCM toggle [font=Courier New]AdaptExperienceUpdates[/font] (default [font=Courier New]true[/font]). Per-player [font=Courier New]delta > 0[/font] XP tracking eliminates 60fps [font=Courier New]+-N[/font] ping-pong spam when P1 and P2 have different skill XP, displays P2 XP popups in Merged mode, resyncs solo P1 cleanly when P2 leaves, enforces once-per-frame decay, and anchors popups safely inside Voronoi bounds alongside adapted Experience Bars.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Experience Bars Split Top-Toolbar Fix ([i]BUG-28[/i])[/b][/td]
[td]Fixed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url] v1.4.6 overlapping Stardew Valley's auto-flipped top-aligned [font=Courier New]Toolbar[/font] in Split mode using live top-toolbar detection ([font=Courier New]DetectLiveTopToolbar[/font], [font=Courier New]8px[/font] clearance gap, bottom-reserve release). Solo play and disabled compat toggles remain 100% vanilla.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]
Tired of being locked into a cramped, static 50/50 vertical or horizontal splitscreen when playing Stardew Valley locally with a friend or partner?

[b]Dynamic Splitscreen[/b] replaces the static split with an intelligent, dynamic camera system inspired by [i]Renegade Ops[/i]:


[table][tr][th]Feature[/th]
[th]How It Works[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Unified Merged Camera[/b][/td]
[td]When you and your co-op partner are near each other, you share a single, full-screen camera view centered between both farmers.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Smooth Dynamic Zoom[/b][/td]
[td]As you move apart, the camera smoothly zooms out to keep both of you on-screen without splitting prematurely.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Angled Voronoi Split[/b][/td]
[td]When you wander far apart, the screen seamlessly divides along a crisp angled divider line perpendicular to the vector between you.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]True Curtain Wipe Transitions[/b][/td]
[td]Cross-map warps and rejoins play smooth [i]WarpOut[/i] and [i]RejoinExpand[/i] curtain wipes (speed-adjustable via [font=Courier New]WarpTransitionSpeed[/font]), with [i]NearestCardinal[/i] vertical exit continuity and seamless fades even when [font=Courier New]DividerOpacity = 0[/font].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Walkable Festivals & Cutscene Isolation[/b][/td]
[td]Dynamic zoom and Voronoi splitting stay active during walkable town festivals, independent single-player cutscenes remain cleanly centered and isolated in Split mode, and true shared events (Sleep / FarmEvent / shared Festival & Wedding) enforce fullscreen with zero P2 HUD bleed.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Unified Dual HUD, Wood Borders & Clock[/b][/td]
[td]Both toolbars appear with outside-edge energy/health bars, side-by-side un-dimmed menus with tooltips, player-colored wood borders across [font=Courier New]DialogueBox[/font], [font=Courier New]ReadyCheckDialog[/font], [font=Courier New]Toolbar[/font], and menus (with neutral parchment interiors), [font=Courier New]DynamicHudSide[/font] auto-swap, and a single shared top-right clock in both Unified and Split modes.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]GMCM Presets & Custom Colors[/b][/td]
[td]Live in-game Generic Mod Config Menu ([i]1.16.0+[/i]) support with [i]Tight[/i], [i]Balanced[/i], [i]Wide[/i], and [i]Custom[/i] presets, Screen-% primary sliders + linked Advanced Fixed-Pixel sub-page, customizable divider width/color/opacity, and custom P1/P2 accent colors.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Experience Bars, Experience Updates & SpaceCore HUD[/b][/td]
[td]Optional zero-dependency compatibility for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url] + SpaceCore custom skills and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7581]Experience Updates[/url]: opposite-corner Merged layout with 4px player-color stripes, 360° Voronoi outer-corner auto-scaling (with live top-toolbar detection) in Split mode, ping-pong-free per-player XP popups, and per-device [font=Courier New]X[/font] toggle.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[table][tr][th]Component[/th]
[th]Minimum Version / Setup[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/td]
[td]1.6.0 or newer (Windows, Linux/Bazzite/SteamOS, macOS)[/td]

[/tr]

[td]Optional — automatic dynamic HUD adaptation when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509]Experience Bars[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7581]Experience Updates[/url] is installed (zero hard dependency)[/td]
[/tr]

[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[table][tr][th]Step[/th]
[th]Action[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]1[/b][/td]
[td]Ensure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed and working.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]2[/b][/td]
[td]Download the release archive: [b]DynamicSplitscreen-v0.3.3.zip[/b].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]3[/b][/td]
[td]Extract the zip archive and place the [font=Courier New]DynamicSplitscreen[/font] folder directly into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]4[/b][/td]
[td]Launch the game via SMAPI ([font=Courier New]StardewModdingAPI[/font] / [font=Courier New]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/font]).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]5[/b][/td]
[td]Load your farm, press [b]Esc[/b] / [b]Start[/b] -> [b]Options[/b] -> [b]Multiplayer[/b] -> [b]Start Local Co-op[/b], and join Player 2![/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Tip[/b][/td]
[td]Run [font=Courier New]dss_status[/font] in the SMAPI console at any time to inspect live OS/GPU/[font=Courier New]MaxTextureSize[/font], co-op readiness, [font=Courier New]SplitPhase[/font], viewport info, and active [font=Courier New]Compat:[/font] HUD integrations.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[line]

[size=5][b]Configuration (GMCM & config.json)[/b][/size]
You can configure every option live in-game via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] (with Advanced Fixed-Pixel Thresholds on a clean linked sub-page) or edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] ([font=Courier New]ConfigVersion: 5[/font] with automatic non-destructive migration from earlier versions):


[table][tr][th]Setting[/th]
[th]Default[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]Enabled[/font][/td]
[td]true[/td]
[td]Enable Dynamic Splitscreen (disable to revert to vanilla static split)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]Preset[/font][/td]
[td]Balanced[/td]
[td]Camera profile: [i]Tight[/i], [i]Balanced[/i], [i]Wide[/i], or [i]Custom[/i][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]MaxZoom / MinZoom / SplitZoom[/font][/td]
[td]1.00 / 0.75 / 0.90[/td]
[td]Merged close zoom, max merged zoom-out, and split viewport zoom[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]UseScreenFracThresholds[/font][/td]
[td]true[/td]
[td]Scale zoom/split thresholds as % of screen ([i]0.50 / 0.72 / 0.58[/i]) or fixed pixels ([i]512 / 1344 / 1120[/i] on GMCM sub-page)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]CameraEaseRate[/font][/td]
[td]4.5[/td]
[td]Smoothing speed for camera motion, zoom, and divider rotation[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]WarpTransitionSpeed[/font][/td]
[td]1.00[/td]
[td]Speed multiplier ([i]0.25x–2.50x[/i]) for map [i]WarpOut[/i] and [i]RejoinExpand[/i] curtain wipes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]DividerWidthPx / Color / Opacity[/font][/td]
[td]3.0 / #000000 / 1.00[/td]
[td]Thickness, hex RGB color, and opacity of the angled splitscreen line[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]Player1Color / Player2Color[/font][/td]
[td]#FFD750 / #40E0FF[/td]
[td]Hex RGB accent colors for wood borders, P2 cursor, mailboxes, Experience Bars stripes, and indicators[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]DynamicHudSide[/font][/td]
[td]false[/td]
[td]Automatically swap P1/P2 unified HUD sides (including Experience Bars) to match their Left/Right screen positions[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]SingleSharedClock[/font][/td]
[td]true[/td]
[td]Display one shared top-right Day/Time/Money box in Split mode instead of one per viewport[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]AdaptExperienceBars[/font][/td]
[td]true[/td]
[td]Dynamically position & auto-scale Experience Bars (+ SpaceCore skills) in co-op (shown in GMCM only when installed; solo play & [font=Courier New]false[/font] stay 100% vanilla)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][font=Courier New]AdaptExperienceUpdates[/font][/td]
[td]true[/td]
[td]Adapt Experience Updates ([i]Nexus #7581[/i]) XP popups for co-op with per-player tracking, Merged P2 popups & Voronoi-safe placement (shown in GMCM only when installed; solo play & [font=Courier New]false[/font] stay 100% vanilla)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Bug Reports[/b][/td]
[td][color=#38bdf8][b]Active[/b][/color][/td]
[td]If you find any issues or third-party HUD edge cases, please report them under the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with your SMAPI log from [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and [font=Courier New]dss_status[/font] console output.[/td]
